prompts.pocket: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: art-directed hero illustration for an iPhone app-store cover; generate the illustration only, no typography. Concept: 'Your Mac desk, in your pocket.' Create a striking photographic surreal still life of one huge deep-petrol teal canvas jacket pocket, containing a miniature unbranded silver aluminum laptop, a tiny silver mouse and one small coiled cable. The laptop is partly open with its back of display facing the camera so there is NO visible screen or user interface. The desktop things belong in this pocket, arranged elegantly as a miniature portable desk, not a shopping bag. The pocket is sculptural, with beautiful thick seam stitching and a lime-green small fabric tab, subtly bulging around its contents. Premium editorial photography with tactile cotton twill, real anodized metal and shallow physical folds. Straight-on slightly elevated camera; objects fill a compact 4:5 portrait composition. Solid warm ivory background matching #F3F0E7, a soft cast shadow. Artful, playful, unexpected but carefully composed, like a high-end magazine cover prop shoot. Keep the top 15 percent mostly empty ivory and the lower front center of the pocket plain fabric so a real app panel can be overlaid there later. Palette deep petrol #145D63, ivory #F3F0E7, fresh citron #D5EF80, silver. No words, no typography, no watermark, no brand logos, no phone, no giant power button, no shiny ribbon, no infinity symbol, no floating UI, no fake screen, no people or fingers, no additional surrounding props. This is a conceptual campaign illustration, not a product icon.
prompts.nightwatch: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: illustration for an iPhone app-store cover for Battistics, whose current brand symbol combines a bat silhouette with a battery and uses citron/teal on dark charcoal. Make an original memorable night-watch character scene, NOT an app icon: a small elegant midnight-blue bat with pointed ears and broad teal wings is perched on the hinge edge of a fully CLOSED thin unbranded silver laptop. The bat is awake, curious and quietly confident, with two small warm citron eyes and a very subtle amused expression; expressive and charming rather than childish, scary, Halloween or superhero. One wing rests on the laptop, the other curves gently around it as if looking after the work while its owner steps away. The bat should have an outstanding sculptural silhouette, crafted paper-clay or fine stop-motion miniature texture, matte midnight blue body, rich teal wings with beautiful folded-paper structure and restrained pale-lime inner edges. An exquisite cinematic tiny set, not generic smooth 3D stock illustration. A gentle crescent-shaped pool of pale lime light falls from upper left onto the laptop. Dark deep petrol background #092D32 with subtle paper grain and a grounded shadow; no stars or clutter. Composition in a 4:5 portrait, scene in lower two thirds leaving empty dark petrol above for later typography and clean space below for a REAL app status panel. High-end tactile campaign photography of a miniature scene. No letters, words, logos, badges, UI, generated app screens, phone, coffee, moon object, power key, ribbons, lightning bolts or other unrelated props.
prompts.train: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: editorial travel photograph for a premium Mac Keep Awake iPhone app campaign. Concept: the laptop lid is closed while the person keeps moving, the Mac's work can continue. Photograph a beautiful fully CLOSED thin unbranded silver aluminum laptop on the small walnut window table of a contemporary European passenger train. A soft teal upholstered seat edge in the foreground, elegant curved train-window aperture, late-afternoon golden light and blurred green countryside outside. No person, no phone, no screen or UI. The laptop is the unmistakable main subject and the lid must be fully closed, partly close enough to see its fine metal edge, natural realistic silver reflections and crisp quiet shadow on the table. The composition feels candid, confident and calm, like an exceptionally art-directed Kinfolk/Monocle travel editorial, not a 3D gadget advert. A diagonal from the window sunlight to the laptop; genuine high-end photographic texture, slightly filmic grain. 4:5 portrait composition. Upper quarter has relatively quiet pale window light for a later design crop; laptop lies around lower middle, all key edges contained. Palette warm ivory, walnut, deep petrol blue and sunlit soft green with restrained warm orange light. Nothing written anywhere: no logos, no signs, no watermarks, no screens, no light beams or holograms, no coffee, no fake interface, no claim text, no extra electronics. This is a lifestyle campaign source photo.
